description_en: The link points to a CSV file that contains statistics on uplink and downlink data packets for a node group
description_zh: 该链接指向一个CSV文件，其中包括了节点分组上下行数据包的统计数据
name: GetNodeGroupTransferPacketsDownloadUrl

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the Instance Overview page in the IoT Platform console.

<notice>
If an ID value exists, you must specify this ID value. Otherwise, the call fails.
If no <props="intl"><ph>Instance Overview page or </ph></props>ID value is available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无<props="intl"><ph>实例概览页面或</ph></props>ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The data packet category. Valid values:

DOWNLINK_PACKET: downlink packet.
UPLINK_PACKET: uplink packet
parameters.help_zh:
数据包分类。取值：

DOWNLINK_PACKET：下行包。
UPLINK_PACKET：上行包
parameters.name: category

parameters.help_en: The query start time. This value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 查询开始时间，毫秒为单位的UNIX时间戳
parameters.name: begin_millis

parameters.help_en: The query end time. This value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间，毫秒为单位的UNIX时间戳
parameters.name: end_millis

parameters.help_en: The sorting field. Valid values: LOG_MILLIS, which indicates sorting by time
parameters.help_zh: 排序字段。取值：LOG_MILLIS，表示按照时间排序
parameters.name: sorting_field

parameters.help_en:
This parameter must be used together with the SortingField parameter.

true: ascending order.

false: descending order
parameters.help_zh:
需配合SortingField参数一起使用。

true：升序。

false：降序
parameters.name: ascending

Data.description_en: The download URL of the data packet statistics file
Data.description_zh: 数据包统计文件下载地址

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. Alibaba Cloud generates a unique identifier for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID，阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful.
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
